claims.text: Three NDA alliance partners, LJP(RV), RLM, and TDP, urged the Election Commission of India to clarify its position on the controversy surrounding the special intensive revision (SIR) of electoral rolls.

LJP(RV) chief Chirag Paswan stated that if questions are raised about the Election Commission's conduct, it is the responsibility of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar to present its side firmly.
The Indian Express reported that two top election officials raised repeated objections to decisions made without their knowledge or consent.
The Election Commission stated that differing views among members are normal and that its final decisions had been unanimous.

TDP parliamentary party leader Lavu Sri Krishna Devarayalu stated that providing appropriate clarification and maintaining transparency will help strengthen public confidence in the Election Commission.

Uttar Pradesh Congress Committee President Ajay Rai and party workers were detained in Lucknow on September 25, 2026, while marching to demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
Ajay Rai alleged that Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar played a role in Prime Minister Narendra Modi's election victory in Varanasi.
The West Bengal BJP chief stated that Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar deserves the Padma Bhushan award for the special intensive revision of electoral rolls.
Supreme Court Justice Satish Chandra Sharma disagreed with Justice Dipankar Datta regarding the independence of the selection process under the 2023 Election Commission appointment law.

The 2023 Chief Election Commissioner and Other Election Commissioners Appointment Act creates a selection committee comprising the prime minister, a Union Cabinet minister, and the leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha.
Siddharth Sharma, the son of Supreme Court Justice Satish Chandra Sharma, has served as standing counsel for the Election Commission in Madhya Pradesh since 2024.
A Supreme Court bench headed by Justice Satish Chandra Sharma overturned an Allahabad High Court order directing Gautam Buddha Nagar District Magistrate Medha Roopam to pay Rs 5 lakh in compensation.
Gautam Buddha Nagar District Magistrate Medha Roopam is the daughter of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
The youth-led Cockroach Janta Party joined opposition calls demanding that Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar resign.
India and Liberia established the Group of Friends on Safety and Security of Shipping and Seafarers on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly.
External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar stated that actions disrupting maritime commerce and costing innocent lives are indefensible.

Foreign ministers and senior diplomats from 23 other countries, including Russia, Germany, and Japan, attended the inaugural meeting of the Group of Friends on Safety and Security of Shipping and Seafarers.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi proposed a Seafarers Emergency Support Network at a recent BRICS summit.
Oceanic trade accounts for roughly 80 percent of international trade, relying on nearly two million seafarers worldwide.
External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar stated that an Indian sailor was killed in an attack on the Antigua and Barbuda-flagged carrier MV Cape Dove in the Gulf of Oman.
An Indian crew member went missing following an attack on the Panama-flagged oil tanker El Gaia in the Strait of Hormuz.
The chief officer of the MV Omorfi, an Indian national, was killed during an attack in Russian territorial waters on July 18.
Four Indian seafarers lost their lives when the MV Golden Leo was struck after leaving Odessa.
Liberia holds the largest shipping registry in the world.
